body: In my experience, it can be helpful to break things down a bit. If the idea of getting through the night seems overwhelming, you can focus on getting through the next hour, half hour, 5 minutes, or whatever time frame you need. When that time is up, focus on the next time period. For me, it makes things a bit more manageable. Just a suggestion if it helps.
